findings.title: Scope fixture copies environment-only directories
findings.scenario: Run unittest discovery in this worktree containing ignored .aws and .codex directories.
findings.expected: Baseline fixture excludes environment-only directories and passes inventory validation.
findings.actual: test_current_repository_passes fails with unlisted top-level entries .aws and .codex; standalone check_scope.py passes.
findings.evidence: Discovery exit 1: Ran 73 tests; failures=1, skipped=1. scripts/test_scope.py:11,18,33 copies the tree without Git metadata, causing filesystem inventory fallback.
findings.suggested_fix: Create fixtures from tracked/non-ignored repository files, excluding environment directories.

findings.title: Retry assertions compete with enabled cleanup scheduler
findings.scenario: A scheduler tick processes the enqueued orphan before the test-controlled failing cleanup does.
findings.expected: Only the test-controlled storage and clock process the cleanup row.
findings.actual: The integration context leaves the default-enabled cleanup scheduler active. Its real-storage cleanup can mark the row DONE before assertions expecting PENDING and attempts=1. Static timing dependency; no local integration failure claimed.
findings.evidence: MediaCleanupIntegrationTest.java:84-95 constructs a separate failing cleanup. support/IntegrationTest.java:17-20 omits cleanup-job disabling; PlatformConfiguration.java:17 enables scheduling; MediaCleanupJob.java:9,18-20 defaults enabled and runs every 30 seconds.
findings.suggested_fix: Disable matbakhy.media.cleanup-job.enabled in this test context and isolate due rows used by exact runDue count assertions.
findings.repro_test: Docker required: after enqueue, invoke the application MediaCleanup bean before the test-controlled runDue; observe DONE instead of PENDING. NOT_RUN locally.
